gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-funnel-san: Electroharmonix splits every word into separate, striking letters with generous gaps between them. Funnel Sans then keeps its strokes at a steady thickness from stem to curve, giving those gappy headlines a clean sans line to land on.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and contemporary, with short ascenders above a deep lowercase band.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-geist: Geist reads like a quiet, level hum, with words that sit as solid blocks.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-georama: Electroharmonix breaks each word into single letters, with open-handed curves in every round one. Georama answers with a wide-open c, like a bracelet pulled apart, and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-gidole: Gidole reads clean and neutral, drawn like neon tube with terminals held apart.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-golos-text: Approachable in spirit, Golos Text fills the line with a large x-height and a widely parted s. Electroharmonix does the shouting with its split-up letters, and Golos Text does the quiet work of carrying words in one even stroke.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-hedvig-let: Gaps that split each word into single letters give Electroharmonix its striking, commanding look. And Hedvig Letters Sans brings small letters nearly as tall as its capitals, which makes the whole pairing feel confidently open.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-heebo: Electroharmonix cuts every word into single letters with open-handed curves, built for commanding display moments. Heebo takes the other job, a tall central band of text whose curves stop short instead of closing in.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-hind-guntu: Hind Guntur reads modern and tall, like stamped metal type with a constant wall on every o. And Electroharmonix does the display work, splitting words into single letters while the sans handles the steady running text.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-hind-madur: Approachable and signage-plain, Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands nearly like capitals, its s curves open wide. Its single-ribbon line weight is the pair's strongest quality against the split-letter heading.
